body:
Whole-program generic type preparation now retains the owned ExtProgram and uses one checked builder for declarations, signature types and body uses. Two independent full-value preparation cases passed after normal Core/consumer compilation. Generic admission, ConstructorFields, ordered MatchPlan and the original Schedule runtime remain unfinished.

The actual finite F03 K/Quint captures now decode and compare across all 95 common snapshots and 94 transitions against each other and the independent oracle. Final non-author review supports whole original UIREQ-021 acceptance; DoctorWatson reports 15 of 35 originals current and adopted. All 25 refinements remain open. Candidate assembler/decoder general installation still requires the remaining guard tests.

Validation: retained four-operation/two-test generic PASS with 427 unchanged pins; three passive F03 operations PASS with 517 unchanged pins; seven separately reviewed map guards PASS with 518 unchanged pins; exact installed source hashes and public JSON/gzip checked; current requirement-evidence reader PASS. No unchanged compiler/model cohort replay. Includes source/result reviews, complete portable evidence and failures, Diataxis docs, additive knowledge graph and DoctorWatson lessons. No new circuit, proof or stagenet execution is claimed.

Minor style notes: the whitespace check flags one extra EOF blank line in each of two new, reviewed source files. Exact audited/tested bytes are retained.
